result.description: A fictional desktop color-calibration hub designed for illustrators and small post-production rooms. The Aster Quartz Dock 4K Color Hub combines a compact media controller, dual HDMI outputs, and a hardware dial for adjusting LUT profiles on the fly. It is positioned as a creative workstation accessory rather than a storage device or graphics card, emphasizing display routing, shortcut control, and ambient-light adaptive presets.
result.title: Aster Quartz Dock 4K Color Hub
